body:
## Question

Which freely licensed 3D models of a drone, a tank, a plane and a boat can the playground use as samples?

For each candidate, record:
- Source URL, author and license, with license terms that allow redistribution in this repository.
- Format (glTF or GLB) and file size.
- Triangle count, texture use, and the direction the model faces (its nose axis).

Prefer small, low-polygon models that stay readable at icon-like sizes. Store nothing in the repository yet. Record candidates in the resolution comment.

Map: [Entity models and representation switching](https://github.com/the-Drunken-coder/Ridgeline/issues/71)

comments.body: Context from [Choose a lightweight glTF loading approach](https://github.com/the-Drunken-coder/Ridgeline/issues/73): free samples were found for a plane, drone, rotorcraft, ground vehicles and boats, but no freely licensed tank. Kenney GLBs reference external PNG textures and need repackaging. Three Cesium sample licenses are unverified. See the [findings file](https://github.com/the-Drunken-coder/Ridgeline/blob/cc6edca4e273378a1a801ad4cddebd753e934cc9/.scratch/entity-models/research/gltf-loading.md).

## Resolution

Free, low-polygon samples exist for all four types, including two tanks. Every pick fits the planned GLB subset as is, except the Kenney boat. That one needs a single offline `gltf-transform copy` to embed its texture. Most picks are CC-BY 3.0 from Poly Pizza, so the playground must show attribution. The Kenney boat is CC0. Models face different ways, and their sizes range from under 1 m to 11 m, so per-model heading offsets and scale are needed.

Method, 2026-10-03: I downloaded each GLB to `/tmp/models`, outside the repository. I parsed it in Node and checked it against the subset: GLB v2 with one embedded buffer, static triangles, no skins, morph targets or sparse accessors, embedded PNG or JPEG, and no required extensions beyond `KHR_mesh_quantization` and `KHR_texture_transform`. Triangle counts and bounds come from the default scene, with node transforms applied. To find each model's front, I rendered top, side and rear views of the parsed geometry and checked node names where they exist. All picks are +Y up. Licenses were read on each model's Poly Pizza page, the uploader's own listing, and for Kenney on kenney.nl and in the bundled `License.txt`. Nothing was added to the repository.

### Recommended candidates

| Type | Model | Source | Author | License | GLB size | Triangles | Textures | Subset fit | Nose axis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| Drone (pick) | Drone, quadcopter | [poly.pizza/m/DNbUoMtG3H](https://poly.pizza/m/DNbUoMtG3H) | NateGazzard | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | 259,676 B | 4,564 | One embedded 128x128 PNG palette | As is; 161,036 B after `gltf-transform quantize` (still in subset) | +Z (nodes `Rotor_FL`/`Rotor_FR` sit at +Z) |
| Drone (alt) | Predator Drone, fixed wing | [poly.pizza/m/3Eio09miiAF](https://poly.pizza/m/3Eio09miiAF) | sftwr314r8 | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | 36,620 B | 434 | None, one flat color | As is | -Z |
| Tank (pick) | Tank, modern MBT | [poly.pizza/m/egcLMSGiuA](https://poly.pizza/m/egcLMSGiuA) | KolosStudios | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | 44,716 B | 760 | None, 5 color materials | As is | -X (barrel points -X, needs a 90 degree yaw offset) |
| Tank (alt) | Tank ("Super_Tank") | [poly.pizza/m/7GG1xDtc8l](https://poly.pizza/m/7GG1xDtc8l) | Zsky | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | 189,148 B | 2,796 | None, 7 color materials | As is; 142,592 B quantized | +Z |
| Plane (pick) | Jet, fighter | [poly.pizza/m/6fyLMORhgGK](https://poly.pizza/m/6fyLMORhgGK) | jeremy | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | 77,620 B | 1,434 | None, 4 color materials | As is | +Z |
| Plane (alt) | Small Airplane, Cessna style | [poly.pizza/m/7cvx6ex-xfL](https://poly.pizza/m/7cvx6ex-xfL) | Vojtěch Balák | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | 36,200 B | 584 | None, 4 color materials | As is | -Z |
| Boat (pick) | `boat-speed-a`, speedboat | [Kenney Watercraft Kit 2.1](https://kenney.nl/assets/watercraft-kit) | Kenney | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | 16,520 B + external 8,814 B `colormap.png`; 25,084 B repackaged | 156 | Shared 512x512 PNG, external in the kit | After `gltf-transform copy` (embeds the PNG; identity `KHR_texture_transform` stays optional) | +Z |
| Boat (alt) | Military Boat | [poly.pizza/m/wouBxOe3CD](https://poly.pizza/m/wouBxOe3CD) | Zsky | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | 69,892 B | 868 | None, 9 color materials | As is | +Z |

Extents in meters, as authored (X by Y by Z): drone 0.57 x 0.21 x 0.78, Predator 1.77 x 0.53 x 1.82, KolosStudios tank 11.3 x 3.6 x 5.1, Zsky tank 1.9 x 1.6 x 4.6, jet 10.0 x 2.4 x 11.1, Cessna 11.1 x 4.7 x 9.7, speedboat 1.8 x 1.5 x 3.4, military boat 10.0 x 6.3 x 26.5. None has animations, skins or required extensions. The Poly Pizza GLBs are Poly Pizza's automatic conversions (FBX2glTF or obj2gltf) of the authors' uploads. Download each from the model page; the files sit at `static.poly.pizza/<resource-id>.glb`.

### Gaps and caveats

- **Quaternius license conflict.** Quaternius pack pages and Poly Pizza still label the models CC0. One example is the toon [Tank](https://poly.pizza/m/Dc4k4CooN3) from the Toon Shooter Game Kit: 2,800 triangles, fits as is, nose +Z. However, [quaternius.com/license.html](https://quaternius.com/license.html), updated 2026-08-28, now says the Quaternius Asset License applies to its assets "regardless of the specific site or platform through which they were obtained". It forbids redistributing the assets themselves "whether for free or for payment". Committing those files to a repository would be redistribution. Avoid Quaternius models unless that is settled. The Animated Tanks Pack versions are also skinned, so they would need their skins stripped first.
- **No clean CC0 tank, drone or plane.** OpenGameArt has CC0 tanks: [pixelmannen](https://opengameart.org/content/low-poly-tank-assets) in Collada, and [danitorres567](https://opengameart.org/content/low-poly-tank-assets-0) as tanks embedded in one scene file. Both need Blender to extract and convert them, which I did not do. All the drone and plane picks need CC-BY attribution.
- **Duplicate upload.** [poly.pizza/m/CAZeAFrhC7](https://poly.pizza/m/CAZeAFrhC7), uploaded by PabloLuna57 in 2025, is byte-identical to the KolosStudios tank uploaded in 2022. Credit KolosStudios.
- **Facing varies.** Picks point +Z, -Z or -X, so a per-model heading offset is required. Sizes span about 0.6 m to 11 m, and one Poly by Google jet I tested is 136 m, so a per-model scale or target size is required too.
- **Draw calls.** Some alternatives I tested have many primitives. The [Silly Fear drone](https://poly.pizza/m/3Ae_y67lzvd) has 65. An offline `gltf-transform join` would merge them. The picks have 1 to 7 primitives.
- **Not verified.** Nothing was drawn in a browser. Facing comes from my own throwaway orthographic renders. None of this is legal advice.

### Attribution text needed

Kenney (CC0) asks for nothing, but crediting "Kenney (www.kenney.nl)" is welcome. For each CC-BY 3.0 model used, the playground should show a credit like the ones below. If files are quantized or repackaged, the credit should add "converted to GLB" or "modified".

- "Drone" by NateGazzard, https://poly.pizza/m/DNbUoMtG3H, licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)
- "Predator Drone" by sftwr314r8, https://poly.pizza/m/3Eio09miiAF, licensed under CC BY 3.0
- "Tank" by KolosStudios, https://poly.pizza/m/egcLMSGiuA, licensed under CC BY 3.0
- "Tank" by Zsky, https://poly.pizza/m/7GG1xDtc8l, licensed under CC BY 3.0
- "Jet" by jeremy, https://poly.pizza/m/6fyLMORhgGK, licensed under CC BY 3.0
- "Small Airplane" by Vojtěch Balák, https://poly.pizza/m/7cvx6ex-xfL, licensed under CC BY 3.0
- "Military Boat" by Zsky, https://poly.pizza/m/wouBxOe3CD, licensed under CC BY 3.0
- "Watercraft Kit" by Kenney, https://kenney.nl/assets/watercraft-kit, CC0 1.0 (credit optional)

title: Find freely licensed sample models
